children: From Udaipur’s luxury island resorts and Goa’s beachfront settings to Himachal Pradesh’s mountain retreats and Telangana’s historic temples, these destinations offer varied settings for wedding celebrations

India offers wedding planners a diverse range of destinations, from luxury resorts set amid the Aravalli Hills to beachfront properties, mountain retreats and historic temples. For planners curating celebrations this season, these five venues offer different settings, accommodation options and spaces for ceremonies, pre-wedding functions and receptions.
Mementos By ITC Hotels, Ekaaya, Udaipur

Located in the Aravalli Hills, around 25–30 km from Udaipur city centre, Mementos by ITC Hotels, Ekaaya offers multiple spaces for wedding celebrations of different sizes. The property includes the 5,660-sq-m Frangipani Lawn, which can accommodate up to 1,200 floating guests or 750 seated guests.

Other venues include the Poolside Lawn, Udaipur Stateroom, Reya Hall, Magical Garden and Magical Forest, allowing planners to organise intimate ceremonies, pre-wedding functions and larger receptions within one property. The resort hosted the wedding celebrations of actors Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda in February 2026.

Set on a 21-acre private island in Udai Sagar Lake, Raffles Udaipur offers a distinctive setting for destination weddings, with guests arriving at the property by boat. The resort has 137 rooms and suites, landscaped lawns and a 9,000-sq-ft Grand Ballroom.

A garden temple on the property provides a dedicated space for traditional ceremonies and rituals. Its combination of island surroundings, accommodation and indoor and outdoor venues makes it an option for planners looking to host multiple wedding functions at one destination. The property hosted the three-day wedding celebrations of Nupur Sanon and singer Stebin Ben in January 2026.
Suryavilas Luxury Resort & Spa, Himachal Pradesh

Located in Kumarhatti, Solan, Suryavilas Luxury Resort & Spa offers a mountain setting for couples seeking a wedding surrounded by nature. The property has indoor banquet halls, outdoor event spaces, Himalayan cottages and rooms, making it suitable for smaller celebrations and gatherings involving close family and friends.

The resort hosted the intimate wedding of Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra and Himani Mor. For planners, its mountain setting offers an alternative to the more established lakeside and beachfront wedding destinations.

Spread across 45 acres along Arossim Beach in South Goa, ITC Grand Goa combines a beachfront location with landscaped gardens and indoor event spaces. Its Seaside Lawns can accommodate larger celebrations, while the Magical Forest offers a more secluded outdoor setting. The Salcete Ballroom provides an indoor option for ceremonies and receptions.

The property hosted the wedding of Rakul Preet Singh and Jackky Bhagnani in February 2024. For planners working on beach-themed celebrations, the resort offers the option of hosting multiple functions within a single property, with both coastal and indoor settings available.

For couples seeking a traditional and intimate celebration, Sri Ranganayakaswamy Temple in Srirangapur, Telangana, offers a setting rooted in religious and architectural heritage. Dating back to the 18th century, the temple is known for its Vijayanagar architecture and location near Ratna Pushkarini Lake.

Actors Aditi Rao Hydari and Siddharth married at the temple in September 2024 in a private South Indian wedding ceremony. Unlike large resort-based celebrations, a temple wedding places the focus on rituals, cultural significance and a more intimate gathering. Planners considering such a venue would need to account for the temple’s religious requirements and arrangements for guests.

From Udaipur’s lakeside resorts and Goa’s coastline to Himachal Pradesh’s mountain landscapes and Telangana’s historic architecture, these venues offer wedding planners a range of settings to consider this season. The choice ultimately depends on the scale of the celebration, guest accommodation, the type of ceremonies planned and the experience the couple wants to create.
